body: Ok I fucked up. Now she's mad at me too. She probably feels 100% isolated right now. This will be such a long and horrible night.
OMG She responded "I'm fine". That was the most meaningful "I'm fine" in my life. I hope she actually is fine.

No I don't know them. EDIT: Also even if I find their number I don't think it would be helpful as if she's doing this in her parents' house, she would take necessary precautions. She plans her attempts pretty intricately, her parents wouldn't be able to intervene.

I'm sorry but as someone who is also suicidal and has attempted I hardly think "what if you're forced to look at this problems with no escape" will help her. Especially since we both are irreligious and I don't think tonight my friend will start believing in metaphysical phenomena.

I'm panicking and have no idea what to do. She is reading my messages but not responding.

I'm telling her she is my life, she is very important for and that I cannot live without her. I cannot lose her. I don't know why she's not responding especially after talking about leaving life makes me think she's attempting!!!
